fg.$description: Foreground — text and icon colors. --color-fg-*. Suffix rules: `-bold` sits on the white / neutral-50 page surfaces (surface-default, surface-page, surface-raised) and must clear 4.5:1 on every one of them — NOT on surface-sunken (neutral-100), which is darker; `-boldest` sits on its own accent family's `surface-accent-<hue>-subtlest` tints and must clear 4.5:1 against that family's `-subtlest-pressed`, the darkest of the three. Note the asymmetry with the `surface` group: there `-boldest` names a three-step band (700/800/900); here it is the single 900 step. Both rules are enforced by src/tokens/color.test.ts over the exact surface list, not by convention.

default.$description: Primary text and icon — headings, body, most icons

subtle.$description: Secondary text and icon — labels, metadata, captions

subtlest.$description: Tertiary text and icon — placeholders, hints, timestamps

inverse.$description: Text / icon on brand/status bold surfaces. Contrast with brand-700 (#099468) is ~3.85:1 — intentional Pegbo design decision (Lexend Deca Medium). Approved by Oleg Mikolajcik via design-tokens PR #40, 2026-06-15. Exception covers surface-brand-bold/surface-status-success-bold only (not exhaustive — applies to any surface using surface-brand-bold or surface-status-success-bold). Hover (surface-brand-bold-hovered, brand-800 #088059) = 4.95:1 AA ✅. Pressed (surface-brand-bold-pressed, brand-900 #0E533D) = 9.03:1 AAA ✅.

inverse-subtle.$description: Secondary text on dark inverse surfaces

brand.$description: Brand-colored text and icon — inline accents, active nav. 3.85:1 on white — intentional brand exception [Approved by Oleg Mikolajcik via PR #40, 2026-06-15]; icon-only at small sizes or text ≥18pt. See PRINCIPLES.md.

brand-bold.$description: Stronger brand text on the white / neutral-50 page surfaces — 4.95:1 on surface-default and 4.69:1 on surface-page / surface-raised: AA at normal text sizes. NOT for normal text on surface-sunken (neutral-100), where it is 4.42:1; it is the tightest `-bold` foreground, so that boundary is real. Raised from brand-700 (3.85:1), which duplicated fg-brand and was the only `-bold` foreground failing the `-bold` suffix rule. fg-brand itself keeps brand-700 and its documented large-text exception.

status-success.$description: Success text and icon. 3.85:1 on white, 3.60:1 on surface-status-success — intentional brand exception [Approved by Oleg Mikolajcik via PR #40, 2026-06-15]. Usage: icon-only at small sizes; or icon+label at ≥18pt / bold ≥14pt. Normal-size (14–16px) labeled text NOT permitted on white or success bg. See PRINCIPLES.md.

status-warning-inverse.$description: Text on bold warning (yellow) bg — needs dark for WCAG AA

status-success-inverse.$description: Text on bold success (brand-700) bg — needs dark for WCAG AA (white gives 3.33:1, fails SC 1.4.3)

accent-red.$description: Red categorical accent — tags, charts, data labels

accent-red-bold.$description: Stronger red categorical accent — danger status text, emphasized labels

accent-green.$description: Green categorical accent. 3.85:1 on white — intentional brand exception [Approved by Oleg Mikolajcik via PR #40, 2026-06-15]; icon-only or data labels at ≥18pt. See PRINCIPLES.md.

accent-grey.$description: Grey categorical accent — neutral status text

accent-red-boldest.$description: Red accent foreground on the red `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 6.13:1 on accent-red-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state; AA at normal text sizes in rest, hover and pressed.

accent-orange-boldest.$description: Orange accent foreground on the orange `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 8.75:1 on accent-orange-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state.

accent-amber-boldest.$description: Amber accent foreground on the amber `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 9.22:1 on accent-amber-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state.

accent-green-boldest.$description: Green accent foreground on the green `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 5.77:1 on accent-green-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state. Green is the family that sets the 900 step: at 800 it reads 3.16:1 there and fails.

accent-teal-boldest.$description: Teal accent foreground on the teal `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 8.17:1 on accent-teal-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state.

accent-blue-boldest.$description: Blue accent foreground on the blue `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 7.96:1 on accent-blue-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state.

accent-indigo-boldest.$description: Indigo accent foreground on the indigo `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 7.30:1 on accent-indigo-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state.

accent-purple-boldest.$description: Purple accent foreground on the purple `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 9.23:1 on accent-purple-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state.

accent-grey-boldest.$description: Grey accent foreground on the grey `-subtlest` tints — soft controls. 11.30:1 on accent-grey-subtlest-pressed, the binding (darkest) state. Resolves to the same value as fg-default; that is the correct step for this family, not a duplicate to collapse.

raised.$description: Elevated surface — nav sidebar, popover, dropdown

sunken.$description: Recessed / inset surface — code block, aside, sidebar inner

overlay.$description: Modal scrim. Pair with opacity-50 / opacity-60 in CSS

inverse.$description: Dark inverse surface — tooltips, dark panels, toasts

neutral-subtlest.$description: Row hover bg — ultra-light, minimal contrast

neutral-subtle.$description: Very light hover area — table rows, list items, icon ghost button bg

neutral-boldest.$description: Scrollbar thumb — rest; also Switch's off-track fill (off, enabled). Darkest neutral chrome fill (one step beyond neutral-bold). ≈1.6:1 on white — the SC 1.4.11 waiver (owner @alehmikalaichyk-arch) is scoped to the scrollbar thumb only: a non-critical, supplementary affordance (keyboard/wheel/touch scroll independently). Switch's use of this value carries its own, separately-scoped SC 1.4.11 waiver (docs/component-specs/switch.md) — the scrollbar's justification does not extend to it, because Switch is the only way to change its setting.

neutral-boldest-hovered.$description: Scrollbar thumb — hover; also Switch's off-track fill on hover. ≈2.2:1 on white — SC 1.4.11 waiver (see neutral-boldest) is scoped to the scrollbar thumb only.

neutral-boldest-pressed.$description: Scrollbar thumb — pressed/dragging; also Switch's off-track fill on press. ≈4.8:1 on white.

brand-subtlest.$description: Very light hover area — table rows, icon ghost button bg

brand-subtle.$description: Light hover area — menu items in active states, statuses, badges

selected.$description: Selected item tint — tab, menu item, row

input-focused.$description: Input bg when focused — same as default, the outline changes

status-danger.$description: Error / danger tint — alert bg, error input bg

status-danger-bold.$description: Danger filled — danger button, error badge

status-success.$description: Success tint — success alert bg, badge bg

status-success-bold.$description: Success filled — success button, checkmark badge

status-info-bold.$description: Info filled — info badge, info button

accent-red.$description: Red accent bg — tag, data cell, chart legend

accent-grey.$description: Grey accent bg — neutral status background

accent-red-bold.$description: Red accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (small text not guaranteed AA)

accent-red-boldest.$description: Red accent — boldest fill; white fg-inverse text OK

accent-orange-bold.$description: Orange accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (small text not guaranteed AA)

accent-orange-boldest.$description: Orange accent — boldest fill; white fg-inverse text OK

accent-amber-bold.$description: Amber accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (white text fails AA — use dark fg)

accent-amber-boldest.$description: Amber accent — boldest fill; white text 4.43:1 (large-text/icon only; prefer dark fg)

accent-green-bold.$description: Green accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (white text fails AA — use dark fg)

accent-green-boldest.$description: Green accent — boldest fill (brand-700). White text = 3.85:1 (brand large-text exception, see PRINCIPLES.md)

accent-green-boldest-hovered.$description: Green accent — boldest hover (brand-800, white text 4.95:1 AA)

accent-green-boldest-pressed.$description: Green accent — boldest pressed (brand-900, white text AAA)

accent-teal-subtle.$description: Teal accent — subtle tint; fills the ramp gap between subtlest-pressed and bold. Single call site today: CW call panel radial-glow core (Requires-Review exception per pegbo-ds-governance §15 — new semantic token, one known call site. Approved by repo owner, PR #126, 2026-07-27).

accent-teal-bold.$description: Teal accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (small text not guaranteed AA)

accent-teal-boldest.$description: Teal accent — boldest fill; white fg-inverse text OK

accent-blue-bold.$description: Blue accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (small text not guaranteed AA)

accent-blue-boldest.$description: Blue accent — boldest fill; white fg-inverse text OK

accent-indigo-bold.$description: Indigo accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (small text not guaranteed AA)

accent-indigo-boldest.$description: Indigo accent — boldest fill; white fg-inverse text OK

accent-purple-bold.$description: Purple accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (small text not guaranteed AA)

accent-purple-boldest.$description: Purple accent — boldest fill; white fg-inverse text OK

accent-grey-bold.$description: Grey accent — bold fill; decorative / non-text (small text not guaranteed AA)

accent-grey-boldest.$description: Grey accent — boldest fill; white fg-inverse text OK

subtle.$description: Subtlest separator — between sections, under nav

strong.$description: Emphasized border — selected card, active section

brand.$description: Brand-colored border — active tab underline, progress bar

focus.$description: Focus ring for keyboard navigation (all interactive elements)

input.$description: Input border — at rest (slightly stronger than card)

input-hovered.$description: Input border — hover (teal accent signals interactivity)

input-focused.$description: Input border — focused (thicker or dual border with outline/focus)

input-success.$description: Input border — validation success. [PENDING: remap to brand-700 — tracked in design-tokens issue #41]

status-danger.$description: Error / danger border — alert, error card

status-success.$description: Success border — brand-800 (#127D5B) gives 4.98:1 vs brand-100 surface, passes WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text (resolves #41)

accent-grey.$description: Grey accent border — neutral status (general use)

accent-grey-strong.$description: Grey accent border — higher contrast variant for WCAG 1.4.11 (4.23:1 vs neutral-100 surface)
